sloka: मम सन्ना मतिः सीते त्वाम् नेतुम् दण्डकावनम् ।वसिष्यामीति सात्वम् मामनुयातुम् सुनिश्चिता ॥२-३०-३९॥
transliteration: mama sannā matiḥ sīte tvām netum daṇḍakāvanam ।vasiṣyāmīti sātvam māmanuyātum suniścitā ॥2-30-39॥

translations.english: O Sita, my discretion fails me in deciding whether to take you to Dandaka forest or not. You are, however, firmly determined to follow me, saying, you can live in the forest.
